summary: Confirmed 20/30/50A (north), water/sewer, showers, dump, 100% reservable to 10 pm day of arrival, Apr 1-Nov 15 season. Added electric 50, 42 sites (35-85 ft back-ins). Not waterfront confirmed for the north campground. SPLIT proposed: the south primitive campground is 3.3 km away with its own entrance. Pin ~570 m off: corrected to the north campground.
flags: SPLIT CANDIDATE (measured): Modern Campground-North (42 RA sites, centroid 41.79764,-91.57425; entrance at the end of County Road F-16, 4 mi W of Solon) and Primitive Campground-South (53 RA sites, centroid 41.79449,-91.53484; entrance 'off County Road F-28 by Fifth Street in Solon') are 3.3 km apart with separate entrances (DNR: 'Lake Macbride is split into two units'). This result describes the north campground, where the stored fees and hookups belong. Proposed new entry: 'Lake Macbride State Park - South Campground', state, IA, location 41.79449,-91.53484, same DNR page and RA link, phone 319-624-2200; 52 non-electric back-ins of 20-30 ft (45 fit 23 ft: 7 are 20 ft) plus one youth group site; 'Standard Non-Electric', no hookups; $14 a night both seasons (DNR rate sheet row 'Lake Macbride South Nonmodern', $14 off-season and peak, tax included); same season, 100% reservable to 10 pm day of arrival; RA bulletin names modern restrooms/showers there too (closed for the season). Its waterfront would need its own call: see the lead below.

WATERFRONT LEAD (south campground, if split): lakeview supported. RA tags all 53 South sites 'Near Water - no', but six official RA photos show the lake across open lawn or through bare trees; the sign posts in them read 48/49, 50/51, 56/57, which do not match the RA site numbers they are filed under (84, 85, 92), so the views cannot be tied to particular sites. On NAIP the southern row (89-96) is ~25-60 m from the lake arm behind the campground's own loop road, and the east end (83-85) ~30 m through a tree belt and shrubs; on-water is not established (own loop road, day-use pier lawn at the shore).
WATERFRONT: north campground not waterfront confirmed. All 42 RA sites 'Near Water - no'; on NAIP the loops run along a wooded ridge with no lake within ~250 m, only a small pond south of site 27.
PIN (~570 m off): stored 41.80278,-91.57417 is north of the north campground in woods. Proposed location 41.79764,-91.57425 (centroid of the 42 RA north sites).
SEASON: RA status line reads 'Open through Mon Nov 30 2026' while the same page and the DNR page say closed November 16 - March 31; written 04-01/11-15 from the stated closure.
FEES: left as stored (North Modern row: electric $20/$26, full hookups $20/$38). If the entry is not split, the cheapest site EKKO fits is South's $14 non-electric and nightly_low would be 14.
